quote: Our goal is to estimate a generation model P (R|V, C) from D and V. Thus, given a new dialog context C associated with an image V , the model can generate a response R according to P (R|V, C).

We present Maria, a neural conversational agent powered by visual world experiences ... Extensive experiments demonstrate Maria achieves substantial improvements over the state-of-the-art methods in automatic and human evaluation.

we present Maria, a neural conversational agent powered by the visual world experiences. It is able to retrieve the visual world experiences with users and generate human-like responses with some visual commonsense.
outputs: generated responses in open-ended conversation grounded on visual knowledge

quote: Automatic metrics include: (1) Fluency: perplexity (PPL) measures the confidence of the generated responses; (2) Relevance: BLEU-1, Rouge-L, and we follow to utilize Embedding Average cosine similarity, Vector Extrema cosine similarity, and Embedding Greedy Matching score. All this metrics are calculated by running the public NLG evaluation script; (3) Diversity: Distinct-1 (Dist-1) and Distinct-2 (Dist-2) are defined as the number of distinct uni-grams or bi-grams divided by the total amount of words.
